description: OASim is PJLab-ADG's simulator for generating autonomous-driving scenes through neural reconstruction and rendering. It includes a three-dimensional scene preview and a traffic-flow editor that selects start and arrival lanes on a road map. Inputs are reconstructed scene models, traffic paths and rendering configuration; outputs are synthetic driving observations and scene visualisations. Geographic coverage follows the supplied scene. Public source is free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that the documented release was tested only with a specific Ubuntu, Python, PyTorch and CUDA combination, and running the supplied example requires a separately hosted model file. The code licence does not establish the terms of every external asset. OASim can support sensor and scenario simulations for road infrastructure and automated driving, related to SUMO (model-sumo) used in its environment. The README supplies installation and launch instructions and cites the 2024 technical report. No model file, road scene or software environment was downloaded.
name: OASim neural-rendering driving simulator
